decisions.reason: The firm built the AVV/DPA management tool as a product line with several models, gave it its own page, received agency praise for it, and the tool fits the announced direction of expanding compliance capabilities, so management would persist with it.
As the flagship platform shown on the home page and central to the agency-focused direction, the product carries heavy investment and public commitment, making withdrawal very unlikely.
The configurable managed hosting plan sits close to the core offer and still has its own page, and any weak results can be blamed on temporary market conditions, so it remains on the market.

Extended PHP security support is only mentioned on the website and is tied to PHP version lifecycles, which makes it somewhat expendable, but it supports the firm's security and compliance promise at low cost, so it is kept for now.
